description_en: Queries the information about a resource group based on its ID
description_zh: 根据ID获取指定资源组信息
name: GetResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: id

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题
RequestId.title_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

ResourceGroup.description_en: The details about the resource group

AliyunResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource group was created. The value is a 64-bit timestamp

CreateUser.description_en: The ID of the account that is used to create the resource group

DefaultVpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) with which the resource group is associated by default
DefaultVpcId.description_zh: 通用资源组绑定的默认VPC ID
DefaultVpcId.title_zh: 通用资源组绑定的默认VPC ID

DefaultVswitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch with which the resource group is associated by default
DefaultVswitchId.description_zh: 通用资源组绑定的默认交换机ID
DefaultVswitchId.title_zh: 通用资源组绑定的默认交换机ID

Id.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Name.description_en: The name of the resource group

OrderInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the order that is used to create the resource group

PaymentType.description_en: The billing method of the resource group. Valid values: PrePaid and PostPaid. The value PrePaid indicates the subscription billing method, and the value PostPaid indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
PaymentType.description_zh: 资源组的付费类型，PrePaid代表包年包月，PostPaid代表按量付费
PaymentType.title_zh: 资源组的付费类型，PrePaid代表包年包月，PostPaid代表按量付费

Remark.description_en: The description of the resource group
Remark.example: Create a common resource group for common tasks

ResourceGroupType.description_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:

CommonV2: Serverless resource group.

ExclusiveDataIntegration: Exclusive resource group for Data Integration.

ExclusiveScheduler: Exclusive resource group for scheduling.

ExclusiveDataService: Exclusive resource group for DataService Studio
ResourceGroupType.description_zh:
资源组类型：

CommonV2：新版通用资源组；
ExclusiveDataIntegration：独享数据集成资源组；
ExclusiveScheduler：独享调度资源组；
ExclusiveDataService：独享数据服务资源组
ResourceGroupType.title_zh: 资源组类型，CommonV2：通用2.0资源组；ExclusiveDataIntegration：独享数据集成资源组；ExclusiveScheduler：独享调度资源组；ExclusiveDataService：独享数据服务资源组

Spec.description_en: The specifications of the resource group

Amount.description_en: The number of resources in the resource group

Standard.description_en: The number of compute units (CUs) in the resource group

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource group. Valid values:

Normal: The resource group is running or in use.

Stop: The resource group is expired.

Deleted: The resource group is released or destroyed.

Creating: The resource group is being created.

CreateFailed: The resource group fails to be created.

Updating: The resource group is being scaled in or out, or the configurations of the resource group are being changed.

UpdateFailed: The resource group fails to be scaled out or upgraded.

Deleting: The resource group is being released or destroyed.

DeleteFailed: The resource group fails to be released or destroyed.

Timeout: The operations that are performed on the resource group time out.

Freezed: The resource group is frozen.

Starting: The resource group is being started
Status.description_zh:
查询的资源组状态：

Normal：正常（运行中/服务中）。
Stop：冻结（已到期）。
Deleted：删除（已释放/已销毁）。
Creating：创建中。
CreateFailed：创建失败。
Updating：更新中（扩容中/缩容中/变配中）。
UpdateFailed：更新失败（扩容失败/升级失败）。
Deleting：删除中（释放中/销毁中）。
DeleteFailed：删除失败（释放失败/销毁失败）。
Timeout：操作超时。
Freezed：冻结。
Starting：启动中

enumValueTitles.DeleteFailed: 删除失败（释放失败/销毁失败）
enumValueTitles.UpdateFailed: 更新失败（扩容失败/升级失败）
enumValueTitles.Updating: 更新中（扩容中/缩容中/变配中）

Status.title_zh: 通用资源组状态，Normal: 正常 (运行中/服务中)；Stop: 冻结 (已到期)；Deleted: 删除 (已释放/已销毁)；Creating: 创建中 (启动中)；CreateFailed: 创建失败 (启动失败)；Updating: 更新中 (扩容中/缩容中/变配中)；UpdateFailed: 更新失败 (扩容失败/升级失败)；Deleting: 删除中 (释放中/销毁中)；DeleteFailed: 删除失败 (释放失败/销毁失败)；Timeout: 超时。

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
